name: Simulacro
summary:
Step into a virtual audiovisual studio and experience what it is like to prepare and carry out a production in virtual reality.

Simulacro lets you explore professional production environments where you can take on different roles, experiment with cameras, lighting, and staging, and collaborate with other users in an immersive space designed for learning, practicing, and creating.
